title: vibe-loop-git v0.2 — C7 Multi-Agent Sub-routing
c7_semantics: coordinated bundle of INDEPENDENT artifacts (per internal/vibecase/taxonomy.go:18 — CaseMixed='C7')
rationale: C7 in dark-memory ALWAYS routes to DELEGATE and ALWAYS dispatches in parallel (internal/v4alpha/delegation/router.go:24-26). The orchestrator-workers pattern (Anthropic Cookbook Dec 2024) is the canonical way to handle 'tasks where subtasks depend on the specific input'. Magentic-One adds plan/track/re-plan recovery. MoA validates layered ensemble > single model. We combine: dynamic decomposition → parallel worker dispatch → per-subtask judge (Loop 2) → bundle verdict aggregation → coherence check.

orchestrator_workers_dynamic.description: Orchestrator LLM analyzes the C7 task at runtime and emits N <task> blocks in XML (Anthropic cookbook format). Each task has a <type> and <description>. Workers receive the original task + their specific subtask description.
orchestrator_workers_dynamic.orchestrator_prompt_template:
You are a task orchestrator. Analyze the user task and decompose it into N independent, parallel-executable subtasks. Each subtask must be self-contained — no dependency on another subtask's output. Output format:
<analysis>{high-level plan}</analysis>
<tasks>
<task><type>{subtype}</type><description>{what the worker must produce}</description></task>
<task><type>{subtype}</type><description>{what the worker must produce}</description></task>
...</tasks>
Aim for 2-{max_subtasks} subtasks. Each subtask type must be one of: code, text, decision, research, video, audio.
orchestrator_workers_dynamic.rationale: Anthropic Orchestrator-Workers Cookbook (Dec 2024) — 'central LLM dynamically delegates tasks to worker LLMs'; dynamic decomposition is more adaptive than pre-defined parallel workflows.

static_predefined.description: Operator pre-declares the subtasks in vibe_publish.spec.tasks. No orchestrator LLM call — directly map operator tasks to workers.
static_predefined.when_to_use: Operator knows the exact subtask set in advance (e.g., shipping a documentation bundle that always has README + CHANGELOG + LICENSE + examples).
static_predefined.tradeoff: Lower cost (no orchestrator LLM call) but less adaptive — operator must update spec when task shape changes.

subtask_routing.no_nesting_rationale: A C7 sub-task would itself trigger another DECIDE → EXTRACT pipeline, leading to unbounded recursion. Subtasks must be concrete (C1=code, C2=text, C3=decision, C4=research, C5=video, C6=audio).
subtask_routing.per_subtask_judge_behavior: Each subtask's vibe_case → tier via judge-mapping.tier_selection_rules.by_vibe_case → model via judge-mapping.model_per_provider → judge with voting if C7-specific OR artifact_size > 16KB (per Loop 2 voting defaults).
subtask_routing.safety_net: If a subtask is somehow emitted with vibe_case=C7 (should be impossible post-validation), force single-model no-voting judge at medium tier and emit a warning audit row.

bundle_verdict_aggregation.rule_definition: Bundle verdict = aligned ONLY when ALL subtasks aligned. Any subtask drift_detected → bundle drift_detected. Any subtask needs_human → bundle needs_human.
bundle_verdict_aggregation.conflict_definition: If subtasks produce ≥2 different verdicts (e.g., 2 aligned + 1 needs_human + 1 drift_detected), escalate to needs_human — the orchestrator's decomposition may have been wrong.

coherence_check.judge_prompt_template:
Review these {N} subtask outputs and determine whether they form a coherent, non-contradictory whole. Reject if:
- Two subtasks assert mutually exclusive facts
- There are gaps (a promised deliverable is missing)
- There is overlap or redundancy that suggests the orchestrator decomposed incorrectly
- The subtasks fail to cover the user's original request

Output exactly one of: COHERENT or INCOHERENT followed by a 1-2 sentence justification.

verdict_map.COHERENT: bundle verdict stays as-is from aggregation rule
verdict_map.INCOHERENT: bundle verdict escalates to needs_human regardless of subtask aggregation

coherence_check.rationale: Evaluator-optimizer pattern (Anthropic Building Effective Agents Dec 2024): one LLM generates, another evaluates; the cheap coherence pass catches structural issues the per-subtask judges cannot see (cross-cutting contradictions).

cost_latency_controls.rationale: C7 cascades can blow up cost. The orchestrator LLM is one call; each subtask is one worker + one judge (×3 voting); coherence is one extra judge. Default 8 subtasks × 4 judge calls = 32+ LLM calls. Caps prevent runaway + provider rate limit hits.

force_decomposition_strategy.rationale: Operator may force a specific strategy when the task shape is known or to skip orchestrator LLM call for cost.

max_subtasks.rationale: Cap subtasks to control cost/latency. Higher = more granular decomposition, more parallel LLM calls.

skip_coherence_check.rationale: Skip only when operator has high confidence subtasks are independent (e.g., shipping docs bundle). Default false — coherence check IS the value-add of C7.

force_orchestrator_tier.rationale: Operator may force a tier for the orchestrator LLM (e.g., downgrade to cheap when the task shape is trivial).

voting_n.rationale: Override Loop 2 voting N. Higher = more confidence in subtask verdicts at higher latency.

evidence.claim: Central LLM dynamically delegates tasks to worker LLMs and synthesizes their combined results. Two-phase: analysis (XML <tasks>) + execution (workers receive original + subtask). Use when subtasks depend on the input; not when latency-critical or subtasks predictable.

Microsoft Research Nov 2024. 5-agent generalist system: Orchestrator plans/tracks/re-plans + WebSurfer + FileSurfer + Coder + ComputerTerminal. Competitive with specialized systems on GAIA/AssistantBench/WebArena.
Mixture-of-Agents. 6-layer × 6-agent. 65.1% AlpacaEval 2.0 vs GPT-4 Omni 57.5%. Layered composition > single model.
Microsoft Agent Framework. Manager coordinates team, dynamic selection based on evolving context, task progress.
Sectioning (one LLM per aspect) + voting (N samples → consensus). Evaluator-optimizer: generate → evaluate → refine loop. Inspired the coherence_check design.
C7 mixed — ALWAYS parallel dispatch (independent artifacts). Always DELEGATE per decideMixed at router.go:119-145.
CaseMixed Case = 'C7' — coordinated bundle of independent artifacts.
C7MultiRecall implements a blended multi-vibe ensemble recall — different recall strategies per C1..C6 child vibe_cases.

consumed_by: Loop 4 (Cold-Start Bootstrap) — uses decomposition_strategy_default + max_subtasks + orchestrator_tier_default as zero-config defaults
Loop 5 (Latency Axis) — uses cost_latency_controls for subtask count × judge voting budget
